title: Untitled Script
content:
Elon Musk ab tak ki SABSE BADI building banane wale hain.
Ek chip factory... naam hai TERRAFAB.

Texas ki filings ke hisaab se... construction 1st DECEMBER se shuru hogi.
Aur sach bolun? Log samajh hi nahi rahe ki ye kitna bada hai.

Manhattan ka ye map dekho.
Iska floor space... Central Park ka lagbhag TEEN GUNA hai.
Matlab... 1,700 FOOTBALL FIELDS. Ek hi building mein.

Lekin sabse crazy baat size nahi hai.
Asli baat ye hai... ki unhe ye banana KYUN pad raha hai.

Musk ne Samsung, TSMC aur Micron se kaha... jitni chips banaoge, SAB main khareed lunga.
Par wo itni tezi se grow hi nahi kar sakte.
Unke hisaab se... duniya ki saari chip factories milke bhi sirf 2 PERCENT chips banati hain...
...jitni Tesla, SpaceX, Grok aur Optimus ko chahiye.

Toh TerraFab chip companies se ladai nahi hai.
Unke words mein: "Ya toh TerraFab banao... ya chips hi NAHI milengi."

Jab ye ban jayegi...
...duniya ki sabse badi chip factory SIRF unki companies ki hogi.
Agar ye chal gaya... toh ye hai ULTIMATE ADVANTAGE.

Target? Saal ke 200 BILLION chips.
Aur zyada tar computing power jayegi... SPACE mein data centers ke liye.

Toh plan simple hai:
ONE. Duniya ki sabse badi building banao.
TWO. Aaj duniya jitna AI compute banati hai, uska 50 GUNA banao.
THREE. Uska zyada tar hissa ORBIT mein bhejo... poori duniya ke AI ko power karne ke liye.

Aapko kya lagta hai, possible hai ya nahi? COMMENT karo.
